evals.name: setup-phpcs-from-scratch
evals.prompt: Set up PHP_CodeSniffer with WordPress Coding Standards for my plugin.
evals.expected_output: composer require --dev squizlabs/php_codesniffer wp-coding-standards/wpcs dealerdirect/phpcodesniffer-composer-installer. Create phpcs.xml.dist with WordPress-Extra + WordPress-Docs rulesets, file targets, excludes for vendor/node_modules/build, minimum_supported_wp_version config. Add composer phpcs and phpcbf scripts.

evals.name: fix-phpcs-errors
evals.prompt: Run PHPCS and fix all errors in the includes/ directory.
evals.expected_output: Run vendor/bin/phpcbf includes/ for auto-fixable. Then vendor/bin/phpcs includes/ to find remaining. Fix manually: Yoda conditions, missing nonce checks, unescaped output, missing text domain, direct $_POST access without wp_unslash+sanitize. No blanket phpcs:disable. Use phpcs:ignore only with explanation on unavoidable suppressions.

evals.name: add-phpcs-to-ci
evals.prompt: Add PHPCS to GitHub Actions so it annotates PRs with inline error comments.
evals.expected_output: Add .github/workflows/phpcs.yml. Steps: checkout, setup-php with cs2pr tool, composer install, run vendor/bin/phpcs --report=checkstyle | cs2pr. Cache vendor/ by composer.lock hash. Add phpcs cache arg to phpcs.xml.dist.
